name: boim-korea-businesses
description: BOIM (보임) lets ChatGPT and agents find Korean businesses: about 2.7 million businesses in every industry by region and category (Korean Small Enterprise and Market Service open data), public-procurement vendors with one-year delivery records (Public Procurement Service open data), and live public-sector bid notices in every field. Read-only, public data, refreshed daily.

interface.longDescription: Ask in Korean or English: "Find hair salons in Sejong", "Which companies supplied traffic signs to public agencies this year?", "Any open public bids for signage in Gyeonggi?". BOIM answers from Korean government open data (data.go.kr 15012005, 15129471, 15129427, 15129394; licence: no restrictions): businesses by city/district and industry, vendor cards with procurement records and vendor-registered contact and price notes, and live bid notices from Nara Marketplace, Defense e-Procurement, LH, K-water and Nuri Marketplace. Results are ordered by relevance and AI-readiness, never by sales volume or payment. 한국어: 전국 전 업종 업체·공공 조달 실적 업체·공공기관 입찰 공고를 지역·업종·상호로 찾습니다.
capabilities: Find Korean businesses by city/district and industry
Look up public-procurement vendors and their one-year delivery records
Search live Korean public-sector bid notices in every field
